title: Deeper/broader independent DWG reader boundary and 3D-evidence refresh
mode: primary-source repository research and read-only local plan reconciliation
scope: Recheck the current public dwg-rs capability, corpus, strict-boundary, ACIS, clean-room, and fuzz-qualification statements
Compare its evidence role against LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf/ODA File Converter, and the existing ACIS/AcDs plan gates
Refine optional comparator selection without changing support claims, implementation order, or validation cadence

method.kind: Read current primary-source repository pages and reconcile against the local parity plan
method.limitations: Upstream dwg-rs pages were read from mutable main and no immutable commit was resolved. The status and coverage counts are project-reported and dated 2026-08-30; the README contains conflicting aggregate percentages. The corpus and expected values were not inspected or reproduced, and no optional peer or native run was performed. These sources are capability/provenance leads only, not normative format authority, producer evidence, or semantic/native qualification.

sources.revision: Mutable main pages accessed 2026-10-18; immutable commit not resolved
sources.observed: README labels project 0.1.0-alpha.1/pre-alpha and spec-derived from ODA v5.4.1. STATUS reports 19 real files across seven version bands, 3,911 decoded / 525 skipped / 9 errors (88.0%), per-record boundary checks, nine AC1032 record errors, and entity types absent from corpus. README verification prose separately states 90.3% aggregate / 85.9% AC1032, inconsistent with its main table and STATUS. STATUS says three AC1032 3DSOLID/REGION records close at the R2013+ has-AcDs-data marker; its geometry adapter uses a bounding-box placeholder for 3DSOLID. The clean-room document says spec/public-byte development with no LibreDWG source consultation, but characterizes itself as a solo-developer posture rather than formal two-team protocol. The threat model lists scaffolded fuzz targets but says extended-duration runs are not logged.
sources.limits: No parser execution, corpus inspection, or expected-value audit. No AcDsPrototype_1b section-to-entity ownership join or ACIS/B-rep semantic route is documented by the reviewed status. Read-side boundary comparison only; not an independent specification, producer, DWG writer, or native-consumer result.

sources.observed: Public project documentation identifies a separate DWG reader/writer lineage and describes R2007 writer limitations and R2010-R2018 writer CRC issues.
sources.limits: Project README scope statements are not a per-version executed result. Peer self-read is not independent writer validation.

sources.revision: Issue #558 accessed 2026-10-18; exact current release behavior not executed
sources.observed: Maintainer discussion reports version-dependent DWG writer stability, an unimplemented AC1021 writer, and better behavior for selected AC18/AC27/AC32 paths.
sources.limits: Issue discussion is a route-selection warning, not a normalized release matrix, format rule, or local reproduction.

sources.observed: ezdxf documents ASCII/Binary DXF support and an optional add-on that invokes a separately installed ODA File Converter for DWG/DXF conversion.
sources.limits: The ODA converter is an external proprietary tool route, not ezdxf's independent DWG implementation.

assessment.disposition: Keep dwg-rs as an optional, exact-profile, read-side boundary cross-check only. Bind commit, corpus, command, per-type fields, record boundary, and skip/error diagnostics. Do not use conflicting aggregate percentages, bbox projection, has-AcDs-data marker, or scaffolded fuzz targets to promote AcDs/SAB/ACIS/B-rep/native support. Require separate owner-key payload and semantic geometry evidence. No peer install/run is scheduled for ordinary slices.
